text:
maria: heads-up — a customer hit a bunch of fncall rejects and their frontend showed a 502. they think it's our API, but it's the structured-output validator returning a generic reject. can we make rejects more actionable in console + telemetry?

sam: ugh yeah. current payload is basically: 
```json
{
  "model": "x-opt-2",
  "tool_response": "[object Object]"
}
```
and validator just returns 400 with no reason. frontend maps that to 502.

oliver: we intentionally kept the surface small for safety, but we can add a non-sensitive reject_reason enum and a sample_id that links to sanitized trace. that would help support + customers triage without leaking content.

maria: exactly. would make console show something like: 
- reject_reason: schema_mismatch
- field: choices[0].content missing
- sample_id: s_abc123

tasha: two questions: 1) does this affect billing/quota attribution? 2) how noisy will telemetry be if we start surfacing reasons?

sam: billing: we currently bill on accepted tokens only, but failed fncalls still consume compute (short). Ops wanted these as billable? we need policy.

oliver: proposal: keep rejects non-billable by default, but add a flag for enterprise customers to bill for rejects for audit use-cases. default telemetry should sample 1% of rejects for full payloads and always include the sanitized sample_id + reason.

maria: rollout plan: add reason+sample_id to validator responses (non-sensitive) -> console shows per-route reject breakdown -> telemetry export includes reason tag for dashboards. start canary at 5% of users for 48h.

tasha: dashboard changes: add a Rejects by Reason heatmap, and an alert when a route has >0.5% rejects relative to successful invokes in a 15m window. sound OK?

sam: alert thresholds fine. also we should add a queryable metric: `sum(fncall_rejects_total) by (route, reason)` so SREs can slice. add a label `sampled=true` for sampled full payloads.

oliver: implementation caveats — some validators run in the adapter process where we don't have the full customer key to create sample_id easily. might need short-lived audit token from control plane. ops-bot, can we request a token flow?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: filed infra ticket INF-8271 for sample-id token handshake. ETA 5d assuming no blocker.

maria: UX note — console must not show raw payloads by default. clicking sample_id should trigger an audited view that shows sanitized content to authorized users only. add an RBAC check.

tasha: also need to decide whether rejects should change routing: right now we have degen fallback that sends to permissive model if structured output fails. that can mask schema regressions.

sam: good point. possible policy: only fallback to degen for UX-critical routes (chat streaming) and not for tool-invoke routes where guarantees matter. or add a toggle at route level.

oliver: recommend route-level toggle + a conservative default (no fallback for toolcalls). we can expose `allow_permissive_fallback` boolean in route config.

maria: testing: unit tests for validator reason enums, integration tests for sample_id link lifecycle, and an end-to-end canary that simulates a schema break and verifies alerts.

tasha: sampling strategy detail: 1% global sample for full payloads, 100% capture of metadata (reason/route/sample_id), and high-priority customers opt-in to 100% capture.

sam: perf: adding reason tag is cheap. generating sample_id and calling control-plane only on sampled rejects keeps latency negligible. need to ensure we don't do extra RPC on hot path.

oliver: ops-bot: can we get a telemetry-backed dashboard template for the console team?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: dashboard request created DASH-4192 with default panels: rejects_by_route, rejects_by_reason, sampled_payloads_count.

maria: final asks: (1) eng to implement reason+sample_id + route toggle, (2) infra to deliver token handshake, (3) console to add dashboard + audited sample view, (4) product/legal to sign off on billing opt-in for rejects. I'll sketch a rollout RFC.

sam: I can pick up the validator change and tests. aiming for PR this week.

oliver: I'll prototype route toggle and safe fallback logic.

tasha: I'll draft dashboard panels and alert rules.

maria: thanks — once PRs are merged we'll start the 5% canary and monitor DASH-4192. :thumbsup:

sam: quick follow-up — what do we call the enum values? proposals: `schema_mismatch`, `missing_field`, `type_error`, `size_exceeded`, `parse_error`. everyone OK?

oliver: fine. add `sanitization_failure` for cases where we can't produce a safe sample.

tasha: +1.

maria: done. I'll include enum list in the RFC and link infra + dashboard tickets.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: status update: INF-8271 created, DASH-4192 created.

sam: thanks — will post PR link when ready.
